Dialogs.Dialog: We were pretty busy again today, huh？
Is even the great ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ feeling a little beat？
Hmm... I'd love to go somewhere and recharge.
Recharge, huh... But with how things are, we can't take much time off.
It wouldn't have to be long. If we could just take a trip for a night or so...
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I actually won a prize. A two-day trip to Atami.
Do you want to go... just the two of us, ●？
...Just the two of us？ Let me think about it.
About that trip you mentioned earlier.
When I said I wanted to recharge earlier, I was actually thinking about it. How nice it'd be with you.
I see... Oh right, when should we go？
The weekend might be best. You can decide the dates.
Let's see, we'll have our date on another day...
Alright. A two-day trip starting on ▲月▲ ▲日▲!
(● and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... our first trip together...)
I actually won a prize. A trip to Atami.
Wow... that's amazing. What a coincidence.
Yeah, you're surprised too, huh, ●. So, since I won... want to go together？
Then what time shall we meet up？
(Well, we can always go on our date another time.)
Alright. A two-day trip starting on ▲月▲ ▲日▲!
(I get to go on a trip with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!)
Want to go shopping for the trip right now？ Is it too sudden？
For the trip？ Right, we need to get ready... Alright, let's go!
Hehe. Let's meet at the mall.
You shouldn't ask a girl things like that.
(Hmm, even though she's the one who invited me...)
(Wait. We're going on a summer beach trip, so...)
I need to buy a swimsuit!
If you say so. Just don't forget anything, okay？
A swimsuit？ Oh, jeez... You're hopeless.
I guess everything works out if I leave it to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hey, no slacking off. I'll help you, so prepare properly.
Hmm. The trip is almost here.
No way. I'm super excited too, ●!
Hehe, I thought so. Stay healthy until then, okay？ Bye.
Morning. I'm glad it's sunny. It's a beautiful day.
Morning. It really is perfect weather for a trip.
Morning. Did you make sure to prepare for the heat？
Morning. Yeah, I think I'm good.
Morning. It's nice and cool. Perfect day for a trip.
Morning. I'm really glad we got such good weather.
Morning. It's cold~ Make sure you don't catch a cold, okay？ I'll be careful too.
You noticed？ I hope it looks good on me...
It looks great, it really suits you!
Yay... That's a relief. Thank you.
(Yeah, it looks really good. This hairstyle!)
Oh, you think... so. Well, if you say so, it must be true.
Does my outfit today look weird？
Thank goodness... I put a lot of effort in.
(Yeah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s outfit today is really nice.)
(Well, I don't really care about clothes anyway.)
Haha... I guess I messed up.
(Yeah. Something else would look better on ●.)
You actually noticed？ Hehe, good boy.
I'm glad. I actually worked hard on this, you know？
Jeez, you're not looking closely enough.
...If it's not your taste, it can't be helped, huh.
How's my outfit today？ What do you think？
(Yeah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s outfit today is really nice.)
(Well, I don't really care about clothes anyway.)
Jeez. Well, it'd be bad if you lied to me, I guess.
(Yeah. Something else would look better on ●.)
It's the brand-new Nene! How does it look？
Wow, terrible reviews right off the bat？
(Yeah, the old way was definitely better.)
How's my outfit today？ Does it look good on me？
Hehe, I actually put a lot of thought into this, y'know？
You didn't have to say it like that... Jeez.
Aww... I'll just have to bounce back from this.
(Yeah. I think ● looks better in other stuff.)
(Come to think of it, today is...)
Hehe. I can't believe we're taking a trip on a day like this.
Yeah, we still have a little time.
It's our first time. We need to leave plenty of time.
Traveling by limited express really has a nice vibe to it.
Yeah, it's got a classic feel.
Classic？ Hehe, I certainly don't mind it.
Yeah. You might end up liking it too, ●.
Which way was our transfer again？
I definitely prefer this over the bullet train.
This time is a precious memory of our trip, too.
Your luggage is pretty light, isn't it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yeah... I guess so. I only brought the bare minimum.
Impressive... Do you have some kind of trick for it？
Well, it's not like I'm super used to this or anything.
I just try not to carry things we can get when we arrive... Stuff like that, I guess.
Hmm, you seem so prepared and relaxed about it.
Jeez, you're already relying on me like that.
When push comes to shove, the guy is supposed to be the reliable one, right？
Hey, today we're newlyweds on our honeymoon. Don't you like that？
What is it, dear？ ...This feels weird.
You can just act natural. I'll still have fun with it.
Really... Even though no one we know is here.
I know, but... I just feel self-conscious.
We will soon be arriving in Atami. Thank you for riding with us today.
A little. Aren't you nervous, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I am. But I'm even more excited than nervous.
Let's enjoy ourselves to the fullest.
It brings back memories of the last time we came...
Let's try to make it even more fun than last time？
Seriously？ I wonder if we'll be okay, ●.
Pass out from having too much fun？ I'm fine with that.
Let's see. Where are we going first again？
There's somewhere I want to go.
Oh, it really is a ropeway.
I hope no one else gets on...
If this stops in the middle...
I'm glad we get to be alone, but I'd rather not be up so high. Hehe.
This is where I wanted to come. Aijo Cape.
Let's see... If we lock a padlock here, we'll be happy together forever, right？
We can't come all this way and not do it.
Yeah, make sure you put lots of love into it, okay？
The padlocks locked here get dedicated at a shrine.
Ours will probably be like that too, huh.
Is that why we were able to come here again？
Hey, hey... Is that what I think it is...
I've heard of it, you know？ They say it's super naughty.
I'm kidding! Good boys aren't allowed in! Geez...
Hey, looks like you can see all of Atami from here.
You're right. Hmm, so this is what it looks like from above...
It's definitely a nice view, but...
I just think night views are the best.
Well, let's head to our next spot.
Oh, right. Should we get some lunch soon？
Come to think of it, I wonder if they have a Dexee's here？
I got it, I got it.
It's in a pretty interesting spot. The view is nice, too.
Phew... We've been on the move since we got here, huh.
Even if it's close by, two days and one night is...
Not much time to relax, huh.
Yeah. But we've still only just begun.
I'm gonna go change. Wait here for me, okay？
(Hmm. Even looking around, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is definitely the best.)
Hehe, sorry to keep you waiting.
What's that supposed to mean？ Geez.
So, the swimsuit. Is it everything you hoped for？
(Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Is she wearing sunscreen？)
You need to put on some sunscreen!
Tanning oil is the way to go!
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Shouldn't you put on some sunscreen？
Ah, you're right. I completely forgot.
I'll put it on myself, okay？
This is tanning oil... Do you like tanned girls？
I'm sure you'd look great with a tan, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
You think so？ Hmm, well, if you say so.
There are still people here even though it's off-season.
Hehe, lacking a bit of self-awareness？
Having you next to me just feels so natural, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Jeez, you sure know what to say.
Phew... Ah, should we get going soon？
We still have a lot of places to go, after all.
Atami is famous for its cherry blossoms, right？
Yeah. They're even called Atami cherry blossoms.
Right, they're planted all over the place here.
Looks like we could do some cherry blossom viewing.
It'd be nice to do all sorts of things someday.
Ah, a souvenir shop. Wanna take a quick look？
That sounds nice, but... won't it be heavy to carry？
We have plans after this, too...
We still have plenty of time, don't we？
True, but... if we get to the hotel sooner, we'll be alone...
Hehe, then I'm gonna go take a quick peek.
(I wonder if she's doing this on purpose...)
Whoa, we have to climb this... How many steps are there？
If I knew that, I think I'd just give up.
Fair point... Let's take it nice and slow.
Sorry, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I can't... I'm at my limit...
...Yeah, me too. I don't think I can go any further.
Considering we have to go back down, we probably shouldn't push it...
Looks like the leaves are changing further up. But it can't be helped...
Sorry, it's because I'm so out of shape.
I should be the one apologizing, ●...
Phew... Thanks for carrying my bags. I couldn't have done it alone...
Haha, I am in a sports club, after all.
The autumn leaves are beautiful. Maybe they look even better after all that hard work.
Maybe so. We'd better take a good look.
This is where Minamoto no Yoritomo and Hojo Masako used to go on dates.
Uh-huh. If you pray here, you might just be able to start your own shogunate？
(Please let my relationship with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ grow deeper.)
(I wonder what it is. I feel closer to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ than before!)
Yeah. I think we'll get some divine favor♪
You can't come to Atami without seeing this.
But man, seeing this as a couple is a bit awkward.
For some people, maybe it is.
I... don't really dislike it. A woman who devotes herself to her man.
Hmm. Is that what the story is about？
Sorry, I don't actually know. Just going by how it looks.
Violence is a no-go, but... Even if he blamed me, I think I'd still devote myself to him...
I'd never blame you for anything.
Yeah, of course. You're too sweet for that.
Ah, we should head to the hotel soon.
Is it that time already？ We did look around a lot.
But the trip's not over yet!
Yeah, not by a long shot.
Yeah, this is where we're staying.
So it's just the two of us staying here, huh.
Do you think the hotel staff thinks we're really married？
I wonder. Though I think our lovey-dovey vibes could rival the real thing.
Hehe, so you're aware of it.
Then let's show off a little more today, shall we？
I'll handle the check-in, so you just relax.
Come on, let me do it？
Right this way to your room.
Please allow me to take your bags, ma'am.
I put your last name down in the registry▼
Whose？ It's the room we're both staying in, right？
I mean... we're on a trip together. I'd hate it if we were in separate rooms.
Let's stay together the whole time？
Hehe, why do you get so nervous every time we enter a room？
When you're like that, I don't even have time to be nervous.
I'm feeling nervous too, you know. But you're so stiff you haven't noticed.
I'm not blaming you. I think that part of you is cute, too.
I wouldn't mind making tea for you every day...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I'm gonna go explore the hotel for a bit, ●.
Yeah, it'd be boring if you tagged along, right？
I don't wanna go if we're not together.
I won't let us do things separately on our trip, you know？
Yeah, maybe I'll turn on the TV. What's on now？
We're on a special trip, so no watching TV. ...Not when I'm here.
But watching a movie together on a date is...
What's wrong？ Are you tired after all？
That too, but I think I ate a bit too much for lunch.
Yeah. It's nothing major... I'll take some stomach medicine to be safe.
What if dinner is super delicious too...？
We still have time before dinner. Should we take a bath first？
A bath... Yeah. Let's do that.
It looks like the men's and women's baths swap depending on the time.
Right now the men's is the Roman bath, and the women's is the flower bath.
Doesn't it sound kinda cool and strong？
Hehe, let's go then. I'll get ready.
Ah, I'll head out first then.
(Taking a bath with my girlfriend... well, separately.)
Let's meet up after. I want you to wait for me right here, okay？
Ah, I get it. Yeah, sounds good.
I take a while, so take your time in there, okay？
(We walked around a lot today, so I should relax.)
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s not out yet. Well, that's normal.)
(Still, it's been a while... Why do girls take so long in the bath？)
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry, I kept you waiting after all.
Yeah, you look pretty cool in yours too.▼
It's so fancy. Mmm, I feel like I'm gonna eat a lot...
Let's eat. Let me know if you want seconds, okay？
Yeah, just over there. An older gentleman told me something interesting.
You can take a boat from Atami Port to an island called Hatsushima.
He said there's a beach there that no one has ever been able to reach.
And if two people swear their love there, they'll be happy forever.
(I feel like I've heard this story before...)
Okay. Then tomorrow we'll search for the legendary beach.
By the way, who was this older gentleman？
He was a very dapper and handsome older man？
He was... probably around 70 years old？
Hey, how about we go back there again？
Back there... You mean that beach？
Yeah, the place where we made those memories...
Good idea. Let's try looking for it again...
They have a ping-pong table here. Wanna play？
You're not... gonna go all out, are you？
You're so mean... Such a bully.
Jeez, now I'm all sweaty. I might need another bath...
Yeah, that sounds like a good idea.
Cheer up. It was just a fluke.
Sounds like a lot of work. I'll pass.
Really？ Well, if you say so.
(Oh, they have an open-air bath. Maybe I should invite ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
(I just took one earlier. I'm good on baths.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, let's hit the open-air bath!
The open-air bath？ Sounds nice, but... I already took a bath.
I see... Then I'll pass too, ●.
An open-air bath？ Sounds amazing, let's go!
(The snow is piling up... It must have been snowing without me noticing.)
Yeah, it's beautiful. I wanna see the view from over there.
Yeah, come on over... Wait, no! You can't come here!
Yeah, it's beautiful... I'm so glad we came!
Hey, kid! What's with all the racket?!
Haha, don't sweat it! You two sure are cozy!
(That was scary and embarrassing. I should get out soon...)
Did you know they have a private bath? Want to try it out?
Hehe, then it's decided. I'll go on ahead, okay?
(A private bath... That means a family bath. ...What should I do?)
I should be a man and...
(So this is the family bath... Where's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲?)
Y-Yeah. You should come in too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Um... The bath looks really nice, you know? You should get in.
Hehe, I'll wash your back. I've always wanted to try doing that.
(Thank god... I was almost branded a total pervert.)
Idiot, don't push your luck! Think about what you've done!
Sorry, my bad. I'm coming over, so let's talk...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ definitely knows what she's saying...)
(Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ said the night view would be pretty.)
Invite her for a night walk
(It's already dark out, I'd better not.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Wanna go for a walk tonight？
When we looked over the town today, you said it'd be pretty at night, right？
I'm glad you remembered, but... it's late. Maybe we shouldn't？
I see... you're right. Got it.
Yeah, I'd love to... But is it okay？ It's pretty late.
It's fine, I'm with you, ●. Let's go.
Walking this late makes my heart pound. Will you hold my hand？
It's a bit of a walk, is that okay？
Yeah, it's beautiful... Oh, the front of that hotel is gorgeous...
Over there. I think those are palm trees, they're all lit up...
▲主人公＊▲. I heard the fireworks are starting.
Oh, right. It's summer, and we're by the sea.
Hmm, sorry, I'll pass. Let's skip it.
It really is different from the Towano fireworks.
▲主人公＊▲. Wanna go to Moonlight Beach？
It's Sun Beach. They say the name changes at night. What do you say？
It glows blue. It's so pretty...
So this is what it looks like at night. Thanks for inviting me.
Yeah... I wanted to see it with you.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, let's head back to the room soon.
(I see, this is definitely a little nerve-wracking.)
I'm going to turn off the lights soon, okay？
Even though we've been together all day... I still feel like it's not enough.
Well, I'm going to bed, okay？
They weren't this close earlier, were they？
Good morning. Did you sleep well last night？
Yes, very well. I'm sorry for making you wake us. Did we oversleep？
...Oh？ I'm so sorry. It seems I got the time wrong.
(I'm glad I woke up early. I got plenty of sleep last night, after all.)
(Maybe I'll just watch for a little while...)
Hehe, such a cute sleeping face.
It's okay. Your sleeping face was cute, too.▼
Oh, I know. As a reward for waking up properly, I'll give you a big hug.
Hehe. Well then, shall we go get some food？
When it comes to hotel breakfasts, it's gotta be a buffet.
Yeah, but I took a little too much...
Here you go. Make sure you don't eat too much, okay？
I'll be fine. Oh, they added more dessert. Want some？
No need to rush. Take your time, alright？
Alright, let's go. We should get ready to leave soon.
Yeah, I hope we can come back sometime.
Today's Hatsushima. I wonder if we'll find the legendary beach.
Yeah, I want to find it.
I wonder if we'll go back someday... to our special place.
We'll have to take a boat to Hatsushima from here.
Yeah, a boat trip feels so fresh. It's a short ride, but I can't wait.
Hmm, so this is what it looks like inside.
A boat you can sleep on sounds like fun, doesn't it？
Have you ever been on one？
No, but they're in movies all the time, right？
Oh, yeah. With first-class and second-class cabins.
Exactly. And everyone's wrapped up in blankets.
And then the passengers get picked off by a killer？
Whoa, it's pretty fast. Feels great.
The weather's so nice, you can see really far.
Yeah, Atami Port looks so tiny already.
Hey. Should we ask someone to take our picture？
Yeah, look, everyone else is taking them too.
Let's ask, then. Excuse me! Could you take our picture？
It's so nice having an island resort this close.
The resort is great, but should we eat first？
Here. I looked it up online and it had good reviews.
The grilled squid with liver is delicious...
Alright, should we get some turban shells too？
Well then, I wonder if we'll find that legendary beach.
Oh, it says something about a legend.
It doesn't go into much detail here.
Yeah. I wonder if it's related to the beach legend.
A lighthouse... Looks like we can go up.
It's not that high. Want to climb it？
It's fine to be excited, but don't leave me behind, okay？
Whoa, amazing. You can see in every direction.
Let's see... Atami Port is that way. It's pretty far when you look at it like this.
Can we see the legendary beach from here？
Hmm, I don't see anything that looks like it...
Are you sure？ Don't push yourself.
We can't seem to find the legendary beach.
Don't make that face. I'm a little disappointed, but my memories with you are more important than a legend.
I'm just happy that we could come here together.
I hear them. Over this way.
The legendary beach was around here, right？
Where was the legendary beach again？
I thought it was around here...
...Oh well. It is a legend, after all.
I wish we could've gone again...
It really does exist. The legendary beach...

Wow... it really isn't
on any map.

It's so beautiful. It
doesn't even feel real...

I can't believe a beach
like this is a secret.

To make it come true,
we have to swear our love.

I, Nene Anegasaki, swear
to love you for all my life.

I, ▲苗字▲▲名前▲, swear to
love Nene Anegasaki forever.

I'm so glad we came.
If we hadn't...

We wouldn't have been able
to see this view.

We've been together
for so long...

Even just today, I've fallen
more and more in love.

To think I'll keep falling
even deeper from now on...

So hold me.
Hold me again.

I love you, and I'm going to
keep loving you forever.

So this is the
legendary beach...

Yeah... Ah, geez. I was
making a weird face, wasn't I？

...I told you about
the legend, right？
We have to swear our love.

I, Nene Anegasaki, will
love you for all my life.

And I, ▲苗字▲▲名前▲, swear to
love Nene Anegasaki forever.
We have to head back soon...

This is the first time we've
been together this long,

But it went by so fast.
I want to stay longer.

It's strange. We both feel
the exact same way,

So why can't we have
what we want？
I don't want to go home.

I just felt like being
a little selfish.

Make sure I never forget
this exact moment.

Not in 10 years, 20 years...
or for the rest of my life.
The legendary beach... It's so beautiful...
Hey, sorry to interrupt your staring, but...
I want us to make our vow.
I, Nene Anegasaki, vow to love you for all my life.
And I, ▲苗字▲▲名前▲, vow to love Nene Anegasaki for all my life.
We spent the whole day together again today.
I've never felt like this before...
I wish we'd done this sooner.
Now, no matter what I do, I'm always thinking of you.
I love you so much, it's all I can think about.
It's okay. We'll experience all sorts of things together...
We'll be able to do so much more.
But for now, hold me. And then, kiss me.
Kiss me. As much as you want.
We're back... Our special place of memories.
It's just as beautiful. Exactly as I remembered.
Compared to the last time we came here...
Do you think we've changed at all？
I love you even more now.
If we come back again, will I love you...
Even more than I do now？
Is it okay if I fall even more in love with you？
Nnn. I guess our trip is almost over.
Time to say goodbye... To this island too.
Are you okay, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ You must be tired.
I'm fine. Don't treat me like an old lady.
We still have a little time before our train.
Yeah, let's just relax for a bit.
Ah, we need to buy some souvenirs.
Just some school friends, my neighbors, and family, I guess.
That's the thing... They're already suspicious since we both took time off.
Pretty much... Maybe I shouldn't. Let's keep it a secret, hehe.
Yeah, it's a pain to get bulky souvenirs, right？
Just what I'd expect, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You're flawless even when picking souvenirs.
I don't need that kind of praise.
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Did you get a tan？
Yeah... I think it might really show.
I'm actually pretty tired. I might fall asleep.
Yeah, don't push yourself, go ahead and sleep. I'll wake you up.
You're tired too, right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲? Let's set an alarm and sleep together.
I ended up having you wake me up after all, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
At times like this, I just wake up naturally when it's time. For better or worse.
Well, it saved me, so it's all good.
We're back... at our usual station.
This is the first time we've been together this long, isn't it？
Yeah... Normally, we'd never be able to stay together this long.
Yeah, exactly. We did something that's normally impossible.
I wonder if something's changed between us from before the trip and now.
It probably has. Like we've taken a step forward.
Yeah, well... I guess the trip is really over now.
Can we do that one more time？
(Come to think of it, today is...)
Hey, we haven't done the important thing yet, have we？
(Walking home alone after a trip... It's kind of sad.)
Yeah, sorry. Um, is it okay if we keep talking until you get home？
I don't have anything in particular to talk about. Anything is fine.
If you were feeling lonely on your way home... I wanted to help. Is that too nosy？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... No, thank you. I really was feeling that way.
Then I'll hang up now. Otherwise we'll never stop.
Bye-bye for real this time. See you later, okay？
We're newlyweds, right？ Kissing is a given.
Hehe, you left yourself open. We're newlyweds, right？
You aren't thinking... 'this is boring,' are you？ Hehe.
I'm so glad we could come here together.
Don't just look at me, look at the scenery a little too. Hehe.
Let's take lots of pictures to bring back with us.
I wish time would just stop.
A hot spring tour sounds nice too.
Atami's fireworks festival is pretty famous, isn't it？
Hey, look over there. Wanna go check it out？
Look, see？ The cherry blossoms... they're beautiful.
It feels so nice... I'm glad it cleared up.
Is it hotter here than in Towano, you think？
I wonder if there's any shade.
The autumn leaves are so pretty.
It's the perfect season for a trip, isn't it？
It's cold... Come here, my little hand warmer？ Hehe.
Hey, make it snow for me？ Hehe.
The night view is gorgeous, too...
There are so many baths. I don't think we can try them all.
Just one night feels like a waste, doesn't it？
I wonder if we can buy souvenirs here, too.
Taking a trip just the two of us makes me feel all grown up.
I'm a little nervous... Does that not suit me？
Relax your shoulders, okay？ Hehe, so cute.
I'll make some tea, so just relax, okay？
We can take as many baths as we want, right？
The maid was jealous of us earlier. Hehe.
Make sure you don't touch the minibar. Hehe.
Is there anything else we haven't done yet？
...What was it again. Did you need something？
I wouldn't call it a need, but... you know, today is... right？ If it's not a bother...
Ah, is this chocolate？ Thank you!
I might have messed up a little... so if it doesn't taste good, I'm sorry.
If you made it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, it's guaranteed to be delicious.
But... I messed it up a little. I tasted it, but I'm not confident you'll like it at all...
No way, your chocolate is definitely delicious, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I've decided!
Aw, jeez, you're mean... But maybe I'm a little happy. Hehe, thanks.
...Hmm. I see. You really did forget.
I was planning to give handmade chocolates to the guy I'm dating... Do I have the wrong guy？
Today is Valentine's Day! Sorry, I remembered!
You don't have to force yourself to take it, you know？ There might be someone else who will？
Please give it to me! I'm sorry! I beg you!
Hehe. For my cute boyfriend who apologizes so honestly... Here, a reward.
I have some special chocolates exclusively for cute boys... What do you say？
